newsitem.title: USA: Picturetel sees Q2 revs below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Picturetel sees Q2 revs below expectations.

text.p: ANDOVER, Mass., June 20 (Rueter) - PictureTel Corp said Friday it expects its second quarter revenues will be four to six percent below analysts' expectations of $130-$135 million.
The company blamed softness in the desktop videoconferencing market for the failure to meet expectations. First quarter sales were hurt by the same phenomenon, it said.
The company will announce its full earnings on July 15.
PictureTel shares were halted for trading on Nasdaq.
